entities.name: Dueling as Honor Culture
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: When insulted, European gentlemen were expected to issue a formal challenge (via "seconds") and fight with swords or pistols. Refusing meant social death. Hundreds of thousands died in duels — including Alexander Hamilton (1804). France lost an estimated 10,000 aristocrats to dueling between 1589 and 1610.
